about_the_game:
Run, jump, shoot, dodge, slide, use power-ups, and do whatever it takes to stay ahead!

In a world on the brink of a great flood, only the fastest — and smartest — penguin will secure a spot on the mysterious Ark! This is a fast-paced platformer where you’ll race against time and other competitors on tracks full of challenges and shortcuts. The gameplay is simple to pick up, but mastering your penguin’s movement requires precision and strategy.

But beware: speed isn’t everything! If you can’t win the race, sabotage it! Throw snowballs, drop bombs, and even launch missiles to slow down your rivals and claim your rightful place on the Ark.

The game will feature various worlds and stages, packed with hidden paths and shortcuts for the most curious and agile penguins. But things aren’t always as they seem… Unexpected surprises can turn the race into complete chaos! Are you ready for this frosty showdown?

short_description: The great flood news has reached the South Pole, and rumor has it that an Ark is waiting to save all species… But there’s a catch: only one spot left! Run, slide, and sabotage your rivals to secure your place before it's too late!
